demo.disclosure: Demo · Sample data. Actions only change state in this browser and reset when you switch scenarios.

PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.title: Waiting for {{name}} to accept
PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.body: The expert is reviewing the service scope, review package and timeline. You don't pay anything yet. Once the expert accepts, you have 24 hours to pay and hold the slot.

DECLINED_BY_EXPERT.title: {{name}} declined the request
DECLINED_BY_EXPERT.body: You haven't paid, so you were not charged. You can send this file to another expert on the marketplace.

EXPERT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT.title: {{name}} did not respond within 24 hours
EXPERT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT.body: The request closed automatically and you were not charged. You can send this file to another expert on the marketplace.

WITHDRAWN.title: You withdrew the request
WITHDRAWN.body: The request closed before the expert accepted, so you were not charged.

AWAITING_PAYMENT.title: Pay to hold your review slot
AWAITING_PAYMENT.body: {{name}} accepted the case. The slot is locked for you; if you don't pay within 24 hours, the request is cancelled and the slot released.
AWAITING_PAYMENT.escrow: Shared Hub holds your payment until you accept the result.
AWAITING_PAYMENT.link: Each PayOS payment link is valid for 15 minutes. If a link expires, create a new one while the payment deadline is still open.

CANCELLED_UNPAID.title: Request cancelled: payment not received
CANCELLED_UNPAID.body: The 24-hour payment window ended. The expert's slot has been released and you were not charged.

PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.title: Payment held, waiting for the expert to start
PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.body: The expert must confirm the review start before the deadline. If they don't, the case is cancelled and you get a 100% refund.

UNPAID.title: You cancelled the request
UNPAID.body: You cancelled before paying, so you were not charged. The expert's slot has been released.

USER_CANCELLED_BEFORE_START.title: You cancelled before the expert started
USER_CANCELLED_BEFORE_START.body: Your payment is refunded in full.

EXPERT_START_TIMEOUT.title: Cancelled · expert did not start on time
EXPERT_START_TIMEOUT.body: Your payment is refunded in full under the refund policy.

IN_REVIEW.title: The expert is reviewing your file
IN_REVIEW.body: You'll be notified if the expert needs more information and when the result is delivered.
IN_REVIEW.overdue: The expert missed the delivery deadline. The case gets a 24-hour grace period; if nothing is delivered by then, the case is terminated and you get a 100% refund.

AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.title: The expert needs more information
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.warning: If you don't respond within 72 hours, the case is terminated and the expert still receives 80% of the fee. If you did respond on time, you then have 72 hours to challenge the decision.
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.responseHint: Answer each item the expert asked for. Up to 2,000 characters.
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.filesHint: PDF, Excel or images, up to 20 MB each.
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.required: Enter a response or attach at least one document.

AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE.title: Result delivered: please review and accept
AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE.body: Review the result below, then accept it or report an issue. If you take no action before the deadline, the case is confirmed automatically.
AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE.principle: You pay for the expert's review work; the fee does not depend on the file being VERIFIED.

COMPLETED.title: Case completed
COMPLETED.USER_ACCEPTED: You accepted the result. The payment has been settled.
COMPLETED.AUTO_CONFIRMED: The acceptance window ended, so the case was confirmed and settled automatically.

DISPUTED.title: Your complaint is under review
DISPUTED.body: The payment stays on hold and is not paid out to the expert until a decision is made.
DISPUTED.sla: A Dispute Admin responds within {{hours}} hours.
DISPUTED.escalation: If the dispute needs professional judgment, it is escalated to an independent expert reviewer; admins do not replace the expert's professional conclusion.

TERMINATED.title: Case terminated
TERMINATED.USER_NON_RESPONSE: You did not respond to the information request within 72 hours.
TERMINATED.USER_CANCELLED: You cancelled after the expert started the review.
TERMINATED.EXPERT_ABANDON: The expert did not deliver within the service deadline.
TERMINATED.SYSTEM_ERROR: A system error prevented the case from continuing.
TERMINATED.challengeBody: If you responded on time or the information request was not valid, you can challenge this decision. The payment stays on hold until the challenge window ends or a decision is made.
TERMINATED.challengeOpen: Your challenge is under review. The case stays terminated; the payment stays on hold until a decision is made.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.once: Each case has exactly one final settlement for this payment.

rules.EXPERT_START_TIMEOUT: Expert did not start on time

package.title: Review package
package.pending: The review package is locked when you send the request.
package.note: Versions you create after the lock do not replace the package the expert is reviewing.

events.responseTimeout: Expert did not respond within 24 hours
events.startTimeout: Expert did not start on time

accept.title: Accept the result?
accept.body: The case moves to Completed and the payment is settled: 80% to the expert, 20% platform fee. After accepting, you can no longer report an issue.

cancel.title: Cancel a case in review?
cancel.body: The expert has already started, so the case is settled under the cancellation policy:

PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.title: Withdraw the review request?
PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.body: The expert hasn't accepted yet, so you won't be charged. To get a review later, send a new request.

AWAITING_PAYMENT.title: Cancel the review request?
AWAITING_PAYMENT.body: You haven't paid, so you won't be charged. The expert's slot will be released.

PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.title: Cancel before the expert starts?
PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.body: The expert hasn't started, so you get a 100% refund of your payment.

report.title: Report an issue with the result
report.body: The payment stays on hold until the dispute is decided.
report.descriptionHint: Describe what is wrong, where it appears in the result and the supporting evidence.
report.descriptionRequired: Write at least 20 characters so the Dispute Admin has enough to review.

challenge.title: Challenge the termination
challenge.body: Your challenge is handled as a separate dispute. The case stays terminated; the payment stays on hold until a decision is made.
challenge.descriptionHint: State when you responded or why the information request was not valid, with evidence if you have it.

toast.paid: Payment received. The funds are on hold.
toast.answered: Response sent. The case is back in review.
toast.disputed: Complaint submitted. The payment stays on hold.
toast.cancelled: Case cancelled and settled under the cancellation policy.
toast.withdrawn: Request withdrawn. You were not charged.
toast.challenged: Challenge sent. The payment stays on hold.
toast.expired: Payment deadline passed. The request was cancelled.

notFound.title: Case not found
notFound.body: This case ID doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

request.title: Send a review request
request.lead: Choose the AI file you want an expert to verify. You don't pay until the expert accepts.
request.draftRequired: Choose a file to send for review.
request.noDrafts: You don't have an AI file ready for review yet.
request.scopeHint: Optional. Point out what you want the expert to focus on, up to 1,000 characters.
request.filesHint: Optional. PDF, Excel or images, up to 20 MB each.
request.consent: I understand: once the expert accepts, I have 24 hours to pay; the payment is held until I accept the result; the fee pays for the review work and does not depend on a VERIFIED result.
request.consentRequired: Confirm the terms to send the request.

steps.s1: The expert reviews the package and accepts or declines.
steps.s2: You have 24 hours to pay and hold the slot; each PayOS link is valid for 15 minutes.
steps.s3: The expert reviews and delivers; you have 72 hours to accept.

request.serviceMissing: This service is no longer open for booking. Choose again on the expert's profile.

dashboard.lead: Track your review cases, pending actions and credits.
dashboard.todoEmpty: Nothing needs your action right now.

cases.lead: Every review request you've sent, from awaiting the expert to final settlement.
cases.emptyAll: You haven't sent a review request yet.

wallet.lead: Credits pay for the AI assistant and draft downloads. Expert review fees are paid separately per case.
wallet.heldHint: Held when you ask a question, charged only if it's answered.
wallet.buyUnavailable: This package has no price yet, so it isn't on sale.
wallet.escrowNote: Shared Hub holds review fees until you accept the result or a dispute is decided.

rating.title: Rate the expert
rating.hint: Ratings are shown publicly on the expert's profile.
rating.required: Choose a star rating to submit.
